heading: 球球器去球.
subtitle: Professor Sybill Trelawney strikes again with her magic crystal ball

intro.label: the Divination Period
intro.title: You have the Grim. The Grim, my dear, the Grim!.
intro.text: Right, you've got a crooked sort of cross... That means you're going to have 'trials and suffering' — sorry about that — but there's a thing that could be the sun... hang on... that means 'great happiness' — so you're going to suffer but be very happy…我呸呸呸

fortunes.title: Disconnected “much?
fortunes.body: Your karaoke song choice will be discussed for years since your taste remained in 2019.

fortunes.title: In One and a Half Year
fortunes.body: A mysterious institution across the Pacific Ocean will one day send you an email that changes your life. You will stare at the subject line for seventeen minutes before opening it. Whether it contains acceptance, rejection, or a reminder to submit financial documents, the stars refuse to specify. However, they confidently predict that you will eventually learn the true meaning of American independence: doing laundry while crying over tuition.

fortunes.title: 早睡到底有多难
fortunes.body: You will promise yourself that you are going to sleep early. At 10 PM, everything will be going according to plan. At 10:15, someone will enter your room with an interesting piece of information. By midnight, six people will be involved in the conversation. You will learn nothing academically useful.

fortunes.title: Viva La vida
fortunes.body: You will have a surprisingly good day for absolutely no reason. Your classes will be tolerable, the cafeteria food will be decent, and nobody will annoy you significantly. You will become suspicious of this unusual sequence of events. Nothing bad will happen afterward. Sometimes life is simply okay.

fortunes.title: The Answer is Yes
fortunes.body: Whatever that might have scared you is actually 黑切白. It will turn out to the best form of success you have ever experienced recently
